label: bge-fleet-one-server-fix
prompt:
Read /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/scripts/lucidota_bge_fleet.sh, scripts/lucidota_safe_ops_env.sh, 00_PROJECT_BRAIN/SYSTEM_MAP_FULL.md, and 00_PROJECT_BRAIN/ENGINEER_RESPONSE.md in full.

Authoritative correction: BGE default must remain CPU-safe (LUCIDOTA_BGE_NGL default 0) on the GTX 1650 4GB machine. Do NOT default to GPU mode. The system map and safe-ops docs identify NGL=99 default as a freeze risk. GPU mode may exist only when explicitly requested by LUCIDOTA_BGE_NGL>0.

GPU-mode architecture when explicitly enabled: ONE llama-server process, COUNT parallel slots inside it, CTX_PER = SLOTS_PER * 2048 (this math is CORRECT — ensures each slot gets exactly 2048 ctx tokens equally). Do NOT change CTX_PER or the 2048 per slot.

Fix/keep:
1. Default NGL=0 unless LUCIDOTA_BGE_NGL is explicitly set.
2. In GPU mode only, force GPU_INSTANCES=1 — do NOT allow it to be configured to >1. If someone sets LUCIDOTA_BGE_GPU_INSTANCES > 1, warn and override to 1.
3. Keep SLOTS_PER=$(( COUNT / GPU_INSTANCES )) and CTX_PER=$(( SLOTS_PER * 2048 )) exactly as is.
4. Keep --cache-ram 0 and --no-cache-prompt.
5. CPU mode may run N servers with mmap-shared weights; GPU mode is one port/server only.

Do NOT change ctx per slot (2048). Do NOT change the CTX_PER multiplication. Do NOT reintroduce NGL default=99.
